question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Fascinating
solution: The correct answer is **"Interesting."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Fascinating"** means extremely interesting or captivating. (आकर्षक, मोहक) • **Example**: *The documentary on the history of ancient civilizations was truly **fascinating**__.* • Synonyms of **Fascinating** include **captivating, intriguing, engrossing, interesting,** etc. • **"Interesting"** means enjoyable and entertaining; holding your attention. (आनंदप्रद और मनोरंजक; ध्‍यान को बाँधकर रखने वाला, रोचक) __ • **Example**: *This is an **interesting**__ book.* • The correct answer is Option 1. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Option 2: Dominating** means having power and influence over others. (अन्‍यों की अपेक्षा अधिक सशक्त और प्रभावशाली होना) • **Option 3: Revolting** means causing intense disgust or nausea. (अत्‍यंत अरुचिकर; घृणाजनक) • **Option 4: Intimidating** means making someone feel frightened or nervous. (डराने वाला, धमकी भरा, अभित्रासकीय) 30:Td0a, The correct answer is **"Hide."**
